description: Doomcaller's Trousers Level 60 Bring the Skin of the Great Sandworm, 2 Idols of Rebirth, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Kandrostrasz inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest. Requirements: - Skin of the Great Sandworm - Idol of Rebirth x 2 - Gold Scarab x 5 - Clay Scarab x 5 - Brood of Nozdormu:
